title: Dream Pet Link 2
description:
Enjoy the endless linking gameplay of Dream Pet Link 2 online for free! In this tile matching game, it’s your goal to find and clear the doubles from the game screen. With dozens of cute animals and two different difficulty modes waiting for you, this is the perfect game to train your brain or relax.

The easy mode has fewer tiles and more hints available, and is ideal for leisurely play. If you’re up for a challenge, turn on hard mode!

title: Fruit Connect 3
description: Get ready for a tropical twist in Fruit Connect 3 – the juicy sequel to the popular fruit-matching puzzle series! This vibrant new chapter brings even more summer vibes, exotic fruits, and relaxing gameplay that fans love. Collect daily rewards, participate in limited-time summer events, and unlock fresh, fruity designs along the way. It’s a fun, family-friendly Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Grand Mahjong
description: Grand Mahjong is a captivating multi-level puzzle game based on the traditional Chinese Mahjong. Match identical tiles, clear the pyramid, and progress through increasingly challenging levels. This game is perfect for fans of logic games, brain puzzles, and anyone searching for a fun free Mahjong online experience.

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow
description: Play Butterfly Kyodai Rainbow – a relaxing and colorful butterfly-matching puzzle game with fresh mechanics and vibrant rainbow visuals! Enjoy hundreds of exciting levels, earn daily rewards, take part in special events, and unlock beautiful new wings. A fun Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
description: Immerse yourself in a timeless Mahjong experience with Heritage Mahjong Classic. Featuring a single elegant layout, three unique tile skins, a time bonus for quick matches, and a competitive leaderboard, this game offers a simple yet captivating challenge. Perfect for players of all levels, enjoy a relaxing atmosphere as you match tiles, earn bonuses, and climb the ranks. Are you ready to test your skills and embrace the charm of classic Mahjong? Start your journey today!

title: Safari Story Mahjong
description: Set off on a bright Safari Story Mahjong adventure filled with animals, plants, fruits, and sunny nature tiles! Match free pairs, clear relaxing Mahjong boards, and journey through a colorful saga map packed with cheerful safari moments. Complete levels before time runs out, unlock Gift Box milestones every 8 levels, and collect helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. A light, rewarding puzzle escape for players who love casual Mahjong fun.

title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
description: Escape into a cozy Winter Wonderland filled with snowflakes, penguins, and festive cheer! Relax with calming music as you match beautifully crafted tiles in this soothing Mahjong puzzle game. Unlock charming new backgrounds and unique tile designs as you progress, each adding warmth and wonder to your journey. Perfect for unwinding, celebrating the holidays, and discovering the magic of winter—one match at a time.

title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game where you clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Play a new puzzle every day, unlock missed days with ads, and keep your weekly streak for exciting rewards! Track your progress in the Weekly Record, where you can challenge yourself to beat your All-Time Best Score. Enjoy smooth gameplay, balanced difficulty from easy to hard, and use helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo to master every layout.

title: Mahjong Connect Gold
description: Mahjong Connect Gold is an exciting puzzle game with captivating gameplay that is known to all fans of the Mahjong series. Collect all the tiles by matching their pairs according to the rules of classic Mahjong. Immerse yourself in Mahjong's unique world and dive into this captivating puzzle's depths!

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong: Tile Match features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format.

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: KrisMas Mahjong 2
description:
This Winter, enjoy Krismas Mahjong 2, with brand new levels and items to discover. Play the classic mahjong game or try the relax mode with a larger grid and more repeating tiles. You can also follow along with the advent calendar that has a new connect puzzle every day! After solving the level, open the fortune cookie and read your fortune for the holidays and the new year.

Discover these levels with seasonal ornaments to get in the Christmas spirit! Or should we say KrisMas spirit?

title: Diamond Solitaire Mahjong
description: Step into the radiant world of Diamond Solitaire Mahjong! Enjoy a beautifully crafted single puzzle with shimmering tiles adorned with diamonds, gems, and sparkling jewels. Zoom in and out for the perfect view as you match tiles in a relaxing setting. Earn points for quick matches and climb the leaderboard. Perfect for casual players and Mahjong fans seeking a peaceful yet rewarding experience.

title: Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match
description: Jump into a fresh and relaxing brain challenge with Mahjong Triple 3D - Tile Match, a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game that brings the classic mahjong experience into a colorful 3D world! In this game, the tiles are stacked in beautiful 3D shapes. Your goal is simple but satisfying: tap and collect three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2
description: The beloved classic returns! In Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe 2, connect matching butterflies in this beautifully refreshed game,  featuring new wing colors, enhanced animations, updated UI, and countless levels to complete . Can you clear each level before time runs out? Collect coins to unlock new backgrounds and stunning butterfly wings in the updated shop! A relaxing, fun puzzle for all ages!

title: Dream Pet Hotel
description: Dream Pet Hotel is a charming connect puzzle game with an engaging hotel meta. Match tiles to clear levels, earn rewards, and unlock cozy rooms. Decorate and furnish spaces to create a unique style, then welcome adorable pets to stay in your hotel. Watch your collection grow as you design the perfect home for cats, dogs, pandas, and more. Relaxing, addictive, and fun to play online — build your dream pet hotel today!

title: Tap 3 Mahjong
description: Match the mahjong tiles in a refreshing new way in Tap 3 Mahjong. Solve puzzles and train your brain while enjoying the classic mahjong motifs and soothing music. By collecting and matching the tiles, you clear every level one by one. Try this relaxing puzzle experience!

title: Tile Farm Story - Matching Game
description: Are you tired of your dull daily routine? Discover the magical world of the remote corners of the Earth where life is in harmony with nature. Help the heroines in the game build parks and nature reserves in the most exotic countries and populate them with the greatest variety of animals. But first, they will have to solve the mystery of the inheritance that the Stone sisters were left by their mysterious Grandpa.

title: Farm Mahjong 3D
description: Have you ever imagined playing your favorite 3D mahjong game in a farm setting? Mahjong 3D Farm does just that! It brings the popular Mahjong 3D game into the charming world of farms, filled with adorable animals, crops, and farming tools for you to match! So why wait? Play Mahjong 3D Farm Connect now and solve the puzzle amidst the fields!

title: Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2
description: Welcome to "Solitaire Mahjong Farm 2," the sequel with more fun! Featuring Quick Play for random layouts and Chapter Division for structured progression. Complete chapters to unlock new ones, each filled with unique puzzles. A new shuffle mechanism solves tricky tile pairs, enhancing gameplay. Perfect for strategic minds seeking engaging, themed challenges. Join now and continue your Mahjong farm adventure!

title: Mahjong Sweet Easter
description: Easter eggs and candies, what could be better? Celebrate easter with our new game! Match as many tiles as you can before time is up and try to deal with "gravity"!

title: Mahjong Linker  Kyodai Game
description: In this Kyodai game you must link Mahjong tiles with  lines maximumThis free game is a good mix of puzzle game and speed You must think wisely but you have to be fast because you have limited time to finish each level

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Crystal Connect
description: Discover the enchanting world of Crystal Connect, a captivating game with breathtaking graphics! Join a pair of dwarves on an epic quest to collect precious crystals and navigate through dozens of challenging levels in this immersive connect-style adventure game. Connect pairs of gems, create powerful combinations and pave your way to victory. Dive into the adventure today and discover the magic of Crystal Connect

title: Mojicon Love Connect
description: 2Million Games presents Mojicon Love Connect: the biggest Mojicon game to date! Match sweets, beat challenging levels and discover sweet moments in the animal kingdom!

title: Butterfly Match Mastery
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical forest in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Free the butterflies by finding identical pairs of wings!

Butterfly Match Mastery is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure. Free butterflies in an enchanted magical forest by connecting pairs of identical wings and enjoy their flight! But don't forget about the time, when it runs out - you will lose.

title: Summer Onet Connect
description: Welcome to Summer Onet Connect, the ultimate tile-matching puzzle game that brings the perfect sunny vacation vibes straight to your screen! Escape to a beautiful, sun-drenched beach where matching pairs, clear horizons, and high-score triumphs await.

title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
description: Sweet Triple Mahjong is a relaxing yet challenging tile-matching puzzle game with a delicious candy theme. Match three identical tiles that are free on the left or right to collect them and clear the board. Each level introduces new tile layouts that test your observation and strategy skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Sweet Triple Mahjong offers smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and satisfying progression across multiple levels.

title: Nine Cards Of Winter
description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Nine Cards of Winter, a fun and relaxing tile-matching game!
Pick up to 9 Christmas tiles and match 3 of the same to clear them. Watch out — if your stack fills up, the game is over!
Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles, solve tricky puzzles, and enjoy cute holiday designs.It’s easy to play, relaxing to enjoy, and full of winter charm!

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Jewel Link
description:
Connect matching jewels and clear the board! In Jewel Link, a Connect2 game inspired by Bejeweled, your goal is simple: find two identical jewels and link them together to make them disappear. 

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and trickier. Placements will test your ability to think ahead and spot Connect-2 connections quickly. It’s not just about what you see - it’s about how you navigate the board to match the jewels.

title: Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2
description: Welcome to Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2, the sequel everyone has been craving! Dive into 150+ exciting layouts and conquer them using powerful boosters like Shuffle, Torch or Undo. With two distinctive tile skins, the challenge intensifies. Can you beat your previous high score? Try it now you have 8 minutes to complete each layout! Play the sweetest Mahjong adventure now and become the best Mahjong player there is!

title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
description: Welcome to the second instalment of the popular Mahjong game that combines Solitaire Mahjong gameplay with the beautiful theme of the legendary Garden Tales match 3 game. Garden Tales Mahjong 2 features incredible 250+ puzzle layouts, 'Quick Play' mode for instant action, 'Chapters Mode' to unlock new puzzles. The more puzzles you complete the more puzzles you unlock. Enjoy this captivating journey and start your Garden Tales Mahjong adventure today!

title: Mojicon Fruit Connect
description:
Match. Collect. Get Inspired! Dive into Mojicon Fruit Connect, the vibrant puzzle game where every match brings you closer to a new discovery. Connect colorful emoji tiles to clear the board, but watch out for shifting gravity and frozen that tiles will keep you on your toes!

Complete levels to fill your Album with cute characters. Reveal meaningful quotes and daily inspiration with every unlock. Return to your Fruit Farm later to claim a basket full of free rewards. 

Play anywhere you like!

title: Mojicon Spring Connect
description:
The 5th Mojicon game is here! Relax and enjoy the peaceful Spring season. Guided by your cheerful and cheeky Bunny companion, embark on a soothing puzzle journey to bring a barren landscape back to life. Match tactile spring tiles to clear the board and earn rewards!

Restore the Meadow: Follow a heartwarming story.
Collect Cards: Find 34 beautiful "Spring Wisdoms".
Relax: Enjoy classic tile-matching mechanics.
Achievements: Go for 100% completion!

title: Solitaire Mahjong
description: This is Solitaire Mahjong at its best, offering a classic and elegant mahjong experience without any need to rush. Known as one of the top mahjong games, it features a beautifully traditional layout that fans of mahjong puzzles will love. With polished graphics, a soothing soundtrack, and no timer, Solitaire Mahjong invites you to enjoy each move at a relaxed pace, focusing purely on the pleasure of the game.

title: Xmasjong
description: Find a couple of identical tiles to remove them from the playing field. If you collect all the tiles underneath, you will find one item that will automatically be placed on or under the Christmas tree.

title: Pet Tile Master
description: Enjoy a fun pet-themed tile-matching challenge in Pet Tile Master! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring adorable pets and match three identical ones to clear them. Be careful—if the stack fills up with 9 tiles, the game is over! Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles and complete each level. Have fun with cute animals, relaxing gameplay, and tricky puzzles!

title: Animal Link
description: Animal Link is a puzzle game, the goal is to remove all the squares by eliminating the same pattern. The rules of the game are simple and require a certain amount of observation and quick reaction ability.

title: Mahjong At Home - Xmas Edition
description: Experience the holiday spirit with 'Mahjong at Home: Christmas Edition'! Dive into this high-quality Mahjong game featuring festive themes and cozy, winter-inspired designs.

title: Mahjong Cute Tiles
description: Enjoy a classic Mahjong game, now in another dimension! Rotate the board, explore fresh tile layouts and challenge your mind. Show off your skills and use powerful boosters like undo moves, tile shuffles, bombs and hints to help you advance faster.

title: Fresh N Fresh Tiles
description: Fresh N Fresh Tiles is a fun and simple elimination mahjong-inspired game, your goal is to move tiles onto the bottom of the screen (there is limited space for that) and match 3 tiles to clear them. If you like playing Match 3 puzzles or mahjong game, you will love to play this game.

title: Winter Mahjong
description: Winter Mahjong is a fun and exciting game of Mahjong with mistletoes and christmas presents! Use your skills, strategy and luck to complete the game! There are some handy features to help you complete the full game.

title: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest
description:
Welcome traveler, to the most epic quest of all time! Test your Mahjong skills as you journey across the world.

It's time to put everything on the line as you challenge these intriguing yet challenging levels. Complete the quest and witness the wonders of the world.

How quickly can you match the Mahjong tiles? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Mahjong Stack
description: Mahjong Stack is a unique tile-matching game featuring realistic 3D mahjong tiles. Unlike classic match-3, blocks appear in stacked piles. Match identical tiles and drag groups of three to the tray to clear. Use boosters to speed up progress. Dive in and enjoy!

title: Halloween Tiles Mahjong
description: Experience Halloween Tile Matching with a 9-space stack. Tap tiles to stack and clear the board by finding 3 identical tiles while maintaining free space. Avoid overfilling the stack to achieve victory!

title: Miracle Mahjong
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Cake Link Master
description: Cake Link Master is a fun puzzle game where you tap two matching cakes to connect them with a line. The line can turn up to two times but cannot go over other tiles. The game has 120 challenging levels, and the difficulty grows as you play. Clear the cakes, solve the puzzles, and enjoy hours of sweet, relaxing fun!

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Mahjong 3D Candy
description: Have you ever thought about what would it be like to play your favourite mahjong 3D game with candies? Mahjong 3D Candy is exactly that! It takes our popular Mahjong 3D game into the world of sweet candies and cookies for you to match! So what are you waiting for? Play Mahjong 3D Connect now and solve the puzzle!

title: Connect Animals : Onet Kyodai
description: In CONNECT ANIMALS ONET KYODAI game, your goal is to find all matching pairs. It's a kind of matching game or connect game ("linker"), that is very fun to play, really challenging and very addictive. If you like cute animals and if you like puzzle games, you will love CONNECT ANIMALS ONET KYODAI, by far the best deluxe version of the Onet type games.

title: Mahjong Zen Garden
description:
Do you like relaxing games? Or do you prefer a challenge? Try Mahjong Zen Garden and choose the way you want to play!

*Hone your attention to detail and planning skills in this classic Chinese puzzle game by choosing the best mode for you.
*120 unique campaign levels!
*Show your skills and unlock Endless Mode!
*Unique design with an Eastern atmosphere!

title: Christmas Float Connect
description: Connect 2 same christmas items with a path that no more than two 90 degree angles. Clear the board by removing all pairs of identical christmas items. Becareful, in some levels the christmas item tiles can float ( to bottom, to uper, to left, to right, to center or split). There are 27 challenging levels in this game. Complete a level before time bounds to get extra bonus.

title: Xmas Mahjong Trio Solitaire
description: Embark on a festive adventure with 'Xmas Mahjong Trio Solitaire.' Arrange Mahjong tiles in a horizontal stack of 9, strategically making trios disappear for extra cheer. Be cautious of overflowing stacks, as it signals the end of the game. Unwrap the joy of Xmas in this simple yet engaging holiday experience!

title: Halloween Magic Connect
description:
A fun and addictive hyper casual game. Matching all the pairs of Halloween Magic tiles to clear the board. Complete as many levels as possible to get high scores and raise your name on the global leaderboard. Each hint will reveal a pair of Halloween Magic tiles, use it wisely. Pay attention on the timer, don't let it end before clearing the board.
When being out of moves, the board will be shuffled automatically if there is any Shuffle item left, if not, the game will be over.

title: Fruits Mahjong
description: Connect the all fruits mahjong tiles and clear the board in this html5 mahjong games. What's the max level can you play?  You can use the "Hint" and "Shuffle" buttons for help.

title: Sugar Mahjong
description: Connect all the candy mahjong stones. Sugar Mahjong has a hundred levels for you to enjoy.

title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
description:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Find matching tiles, solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more. 
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. You will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more.

title: Mahjong Tour
description: Mahjong Tour game is a cool mahjong game with colorful graphics,  challenging levels and appealing themes. Match tiles of the same type and watch them flutter away. Once you clear the screen, the level is finished and you can move on to the next.

title: The Sort Agency
description: You are the head of the best object sorting agency. Your goal is to bring order and cleanliness to the world. On the many levels you will be able to test your attentiveness and tactical thinking. Look for the right items in a pile of other items. But keep track of how many items you already have in your hands!

title: Tile Connect - Pair Matching
description:
Tile Connect is a tile-matching game for both kids and adults. Play and relax in your free time!  

It offers beautiful themes and music for much fun! With the memory of your brain and concentration of your mind, you search pairs and connect to turn them into stars! The higher level you get more challenging it is, but various tools and treasure boxes are there for help! So play and enjoy it now! Classic and boring merging games. This is a new, free, and cool game for boys and girls.

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Catch The Snowflake
description: In Catch The Snowflake, be prepared to test your attention! Snowflakes and Christmas trees  decorate the tiles in this game, and all you have to do is to link them together. How many points do you think you can earn before the timer hits zero?

title: Mojicon Winter Connect
description:
The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

title: Bang Bang Mahjong
description:
In Bang Bang Mahjong, we mix classic Mahjong with a sliding puzzle twist. It might seem simple at first, but as the levels get trickier, every move counts. Move the tiles around and match identical ones.

Power-ups like shuffle, remove, or hints can help when things get tough. With each completed level, the challenge grows—but so does the satisfaction of solving it. Who can master every puzzle and clear the board like a pro?

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
description: Mahjong Connect is a classic elimination-style casual game where players need to find and connect identical mahjong tiles on the board. The game rules are simple yet challenging, suitable for players of all ages.

title: Farm Tiles Harvest
description: Dive into 'Farm Tiles Harvest,' an engaging tile-matching game set in a quaint farm setting! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring fruits, veggies, and farming tools. Try to draw 3 similar tiles to clear them, or drawing the 9th tile will end the game. Shuffle tiles to reveal hidden ones, and complete each level within the time limit. Can you harvest them all?

title: Mahjong Slide Puzzle
description: Experience the thrill of Mahjong puzzles! Strategically match tiles, clear the board, and conquer challenging levels to achieve high scores!

title: Christmas Connect Deluxe
description: This is a classic puzzle game, inspired by popular Chinese Block removal game, Mahjong. In this you need to eliminate all the tiles appearing on the board. If 2 identical tiles can be connected using 3 or less straight lines, both will be eliminated. To connect them, simply tap on those tiles.  There are 24 challenging levels in this game. Complete a level before time bounds to get extra bonus.

title: Happy Halloween
description:
Are you looking for some fun and excitement this Halloween?
 Then get ready to have some fun as you play Happy Halloween.

 Swipe on the items of the same type to destroy them and unlock all levels.
 Try to remove all casket and make the bats and ghost fall to the bottom row.
 Complete all the requirements within the given move and time.

 See how far you can get. Play NOW!

 Features:
 * cute characters: Moon, Pumpkin, Candies, Witch hat, bat, ghost and casket.
 * cool design and animation
 * perfect graphics and effects
 * entertaining background music and sound effects
 * challenging levels
 * 4 Power-Ups that will help you in the game: Hand to add 5 moves; Broom to remove one character; Potion to remove 9 characters; and Skull to remove all characters lined horizontally.
 * You may also use Special Power and Mixed Power

title: Happy Fruit Link
description: Enjoy a fun and relaxing puzzle adventure in Happy Fruit Link! Match two identical fruit tiles and connect them with a line that can turn up to two times. Clear all tiles, solve challenging puzzles, and test your brain through exciting levels. With colorful graphics and smooth gameplay.

title: Winter Connect
description: Winter connect is a fun to play tile connect game. You need to connect two identical tiles. The Connecting Line between two matching blocks can have only two turns. Make connections between the matching tiles while you fight to keep up with the clock. Can you clear the board before time runs out?

title: Melty time
description: Sweets Mahjong Solitaire! Let's find the same sweets and make them disappear. Connnect and erase the same sweets within three straight lines horizontally and vertically. If you don't erase it carefully, you'll get stuck.

title: Tap 3D Blocks
description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Onet Winter Christmas Mahjong
description: Onet Winter Christmas Mahjong is a fun and relaxing cute mahjong connect game. Your task is to find pairs and remove all tiles from the board. The path between two tiles can't have more than three lines or two 90 degree angles though. You can use "Hint" or "Shuffle" to help. Play strategically because some levels the tiles can move. If you have no shuffle left, the game is over! How many score can you beat?

title: Mahjong Tiles Christmas
description: Mahjong Tiles Christmas is winter theme game. Collect the pairs of identical tiles by clicking or tapping them. You can collect only those tiles which are open from either left or right side. Collect all the tiles to complete a level. Complete all the levels to win the game.

title: Winter Tiles
description: Enjoy 'Winter Tiles' with a festive theme! Match and collect pairs of identical winter-themed tiles. Click or tap two tiles with a clear path between them with no more than two turns. Collect all the winter-themed tiles within the time limit to advance to the next level.

title: Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures
description:
Ready to go on a magical quest through a land made of candy?
Jump into Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures - where every corner is bursting with sweetness and surprises!

The streets are sprinkled with tasty treats, and they’re all yours to match! Find the snacky pairs, clear the board, and munch your way through this delicious adventure.

Can you collect all the colorful, candy-coated tiles? Play now and let's find out!

title: Word Link
description: The new Words Link Puzzle Game with new thousands of words!Do you enjoy the excitement of classic word games? Are you a real puzzle game master? Simply swipe the letter blocks and build words to collect coins! Find the clues to solve the crossword puzzles! Play Word Link NOW to begin training your brain and become a word master!It’s time to uncover hidden words and build as many words as possible! Come and begin your word story!What makes Word Link so special?

title: Valentines Love Link
description: Valentines Love Link is a cute and relaxing matching puzzle game full of hearts, roses, chocolates, and love symbols. Connect matching Valentines items with straight lines, allowing up to two turns. Beat the clock across 48 levels by collecting all tiles and enjoy a sweet romantic theme.

title: Summer Triple Mahjong
description: Enjoy a relaxing summer puzzle adventure in Summer Triple Mahjong!Match and collect 3 identical tiles that are free on the left or right side. Clear all the tiles before time runs out to complete the level and unlock new challenges. If you get stuck, use the Hint feature to help you find matches. If the time runs out, you can watch a reward ad to pause the timer and keep playing.

title: Xmas Presents Mahjong
description: Match three of the same tiles. Click on a tile to move it to the collection spots at the bottom. If you have collected three of the same tiles there, they will be removed.

title: Word Connect
description: Try to find all of the hidden words by connecting each letter together

title: Tiles Matching
description:
Free online game Tiles Matching - play in the browser without downloading. It is suitable for the development of logic for both adults and children - an ideal timekiller.
Tiles Matching is a puzzle game combining the game mechanics of Mahjong and Three in a Row (Match-3). A logical educational game for children and adults. With each level, the difficulty increases - not everyone can complete the game the first time. Challenge your intelligence.

title: Mahjong Frenzy
description: Go crazy with this addictive mahjong game. Your goal is to pair identical tiles to eliminate them from the game board. Successfully remove all the tiles to conquer each puzzle. Return daily to unlock rewards and discover fresh challenges.

title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
description: Step into the Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels. Match mystical tiles adorned with enchanting artifacts. Collect only open tiles that don't have adjacent tiles to the left or right. Gather all the tile sets to win each level. Conquer 60 levels within the time limits to complete this game. Uncover magical secrets to become the ultimate magician!

title: Tile Adventure
description: A fun and satisfying tile-matching puzzle game! Match tiles in sets of three, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing, brain-teasing experience. With smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and levels that gradually increase in challenge, it’s perfect for anyone who loves casual puzzles. (Inspired by the classic Mahjong layout, but with a fresh, modern twist!)

title: Mahjong Classic
description: Relax and challenge your mind with Mahjong Classic, a timeless tile-matching puzzle game with a beautiful, traditional aesthetic. Enjoy the calming backdrop and classic gameplay as you match identical tiles to eliminate them from the board. The goal is simple: clear all the tiles to win the game. But it’s not just about matching any tiles—only the free tiles on the edge can be selected, adding a layer of strategy and focus to your gameplay.

title: Mahjong Seasons 2 - Autumn and Winter
description:
Mahjong Seasons 2 is another edition of a great logic puzzle game with pair-matching, this time light up the stove and get ready for a beautiful autumn and icy winter! Enjoy endless puzzles here and be the fastest at matching pairs!

Remember that the line connecting a pair can only make two turns!

title: Xmas Mahjong
description: Connect the all christams tiles and clear the board in this html5 mahjong games. What's the max level can you play?  You can use the "Hint" and "Shuffle" buttons for help.

title: Christmas Mahjong
description: Simplified classic Mahjong game with Xmas theme. You can eliminate pair of similar items. You can select only those pairs which have at least 2 adjacent sides open.

title: Panda Mahjong Classic
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Merry Christmas Connect
description: 《Cute Animal Connect》is a classic puzzle game where you connect identical patterns to eliminate them and score points. It tests your observation skills and reaction speed, with simple yet addictive gameplay that appeals to players of all ages.

title: Xmas Mahjong Deluxe
description: Match 2 of the same xmas mahjong tiles to remove them from the board. You only can use free tiles. A free tile is not covered by other tiles and at least 1 side (left or right) is open. You have 24 levels (each level is a symbol of a christmas item) to challenge in this christmas games. Can you finish the all levels with 3 stars?

title: Sunny Link
description: 'Sunny Link' is an easy and fun game where players match tiles with summer icons. The goal is to connect two identical tiles. Tiles can be linked if you can join them with three or fewer straight lines. The game has many levels to enjoy. As you play, you’ll hear sounds of the sea. It’s perfect for relaxing and having fun in the sun!

title: Sea Monsters Mahjong
description: Dive into 'Sea Monsters Mahjong,' an underwater twist on the classic game. Match sea monster tiles strategically—remember, you can only draw tiles that are on top of a stack with no blocks on their sides. Explore the depths, revealing krakens, dolphins, and mermaids. With easy controls and oceanic vibes, enjoy a relaxing Mahjong experience with charming sea creatures.

title: Xmas Triple Mahjong
description: "Xmas Triple Mahjong" is a festive take on the classic game. Match three identical Christmas-themed tiles with at least 2 open sides. With 18 challenging levels, hints are available for assistance. Can you conquer this holiday Mahjong challenge?

title: Spooky Link
description: Spooky Link is a relaxing Halloween-themed game where you connect matching spooky tiles. Tap a tile, then tap its match. If the path between them has two or fewer turns, the tiles are cleared. Each cleared tile creates more space to connect others. Enjoy many levels of fun with Halloween surprises!

title: Mahjong Seasons 1 - Spring and Summer
description: In Mahjong Seasons 1 - SpringSummer, your objective is to clear the Mahjong board by matching pairs of identical tiles. Each tile features unique symbols inspired by the beauty of spring and summer, such as blooming flowers, chirping birds, radiant sunshine, and more. Uncover and eliminate tiles strategically to reveal hidden ones and progress through the levels.

title: Ninja Spell Match
description: Ninja Spell Match is a fast-paced blend of match-3 puzzling and ninja action. Connect tiles to charge up your attacks and unleash devastating moves against waves of enemies. With each level, the challenge grows tougher as you fight your way through 30 unique stages packed with traps, puzzles, and rival ninjas. Think fast, match smart, and strike hard—your reflexes and strategy are the only way to survive.

title: Xmas Float Connect 2023
description: Connect 2 same xmas items with a path that no more than two 90 degree angles. Clear the board by removing all pairs of identical xmas items. Becareful, in some levels the item tiles can float ( to bottom, to uper, to left, to right, to center or split). There are 27 challenging levels in this game. Complete a level before time bounds to get extra bonus.

title: Connect The Dots Game For Kids
description: Game designed for number learning and tracing with the help of fun activities along. With each completed picture, the kids will hear the English pronunciation of it. The activities are not time limited and therefore encourage kids to learn at their own pace.

title: Mahjong Blitz
description: Enjoy unique tile matching! Mahjong is based on simple rules and has addictive gameplay. Your aim is to clear up the board of stones, but you are able to remove only paired and free tiles. The tile is free when there are no tiles either to the left or to the right from it. It is a game of skill, intelligence, calculation and luck. If you are already a fan of mahjong or are looking for a good title to start playing, this one will be a good choice.

title: Madcap Mahjong
description: A crazy, fast-paced, tile-matching, mahjong game. Match all the tiles and clear the board to beat your best time! Or play casually at your own pace.

title: Fruit Mahjong 3D
description: Fruit Mahjong 3D is a relaxing puzzle game where you match pairs of fruit-themed tiles in 3D space. Rotate the view, find free tiles, and clear the board by matching identical pieces. Each level is handcrafted and fully solvable, offering a mix of easy and challenging layouts. The game starts with a short tutorial and gradually increases in difficulty. Use shuffle and hint buttons if you get stuck. Enjoy colorful graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls on both mobile and desktop.

title: Summer Connect
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with summer theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching summer tiles with 30 puzzle stages in this game.

title: Winter Mahjong
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with winter christmas theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching winter tiles with 32 levels in this game.

title: Xmas Mahjong Tiles 2023
description: Xmas Mahjong Tiles is the classic tile-matching game with christmas theme.  Match the pairs of the same tiles to clear them. You can select only those pairs which have either left or right side open. You need to clear all the tiles before the time runs out, then play as fast as possible. Hints and Shuffles buttons can help you.

title: 25 December
description: Merge identical dates by moving them in any direction with the help of arrow keys or swiping your figure on the screen or swiping mouse pointer. Each time you merge two dates you reach to a new date. Just give a try to see can you reach to 25 December? You can shuffle the board or regroup the items for limited number of times.

title: Mahjong Masters
description:
Enter the world of Mahjong Masters, where classic Mahjong meets fast-paced tile matching! 
In this exciting game, players have 2 minutes to match as many Mahjong tile pairs as possible. 
Each round is a thrilling battle against a new opponent. 
Accumulate battle points with each victory to climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate Mahjong Master.

title: Pirates Mahjong
description: Pirates Mahjong is a classic tile-matching game featuring challenging levels. Match pairs of pirate-themed tiles to clear the board, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden tiles along the way. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and pirate fans alike, Pirates Mahjong offers endless fun and excitement on the high seas!

title: Xmas 2020 Mahjong Deluxe
description: Match 2 of the same christmas mahjong tiles to remove them from the board. You only can use free tiles. A free tile is not covered by other tiles and at least 1 side (left or right) is open. You have 48 levels to challenge in this christmas mahjong deluxe games. Can you finish the all levels with 3 stars?

title: Link Line Puzzle
description:
- The game contains a matrix of square, the size of matrix is 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 8x8, 9x9, 10x10 depends on level you are playing and difficulty level you want to challenge.
- Your mission is about to connect two dots which have same color by drawing line between them. The mission will be completed when all below conditions are met:
1. All same color dots are connected in pair.
2. There are no intersect of any line.
3. All the squares in the matrix are filled with the lines.
The difficulty will increase because there are more color dots when level up. There are thousands levels for you to challenge.

title: Candy Connect
description:
Simple to play but difficult to master. Puzzles range from beginner to expert featuring increasingly difficult hex block puzzles.
Completely free to play with no time limits, and no locked puzzle packs.
Hundreds of unique levels will keep your brain sharp.
Relax and relieve your stress while exercising your mind.

title: Mahjong Connect: Spooky
description: Connect two tiles of an identical type. A move can only be made if there are 2 or fewer bends in the line between them. Clear the board to advance to the next level, but be warned, the game is time sensitive.

title: Fruits Link Match3
description:
Welcome to Fruits Link Match3 Puzzle Game.
Slide to link 3 or more identical Fruits and complete your level as fast as you can.
Explore Tons of amazing and challenging levels and try to complete them all.
Good luck!

title: Connection!
description: A relaxing, fun and very addictive puzzle game to challenge and train your Brain. Just try to connect all the dots with only one touch. In this tricky mind game you will find a lot of good brain puzzle challenges. Find the best pathway to complete a shape, one stroke at a time! Just a couple of minutes a day with this mind game will help you activate your brain. Enjoy this brain training game at home or at work, at a park or in a bus, in other words everywhere!

title: Candy Connection
description: Today we present to you the puzzle game Candy Connection. In it we have to solve a rather interesting puzzle. Before us there will be a field divided into the same number of squares. In some of them there will be sweets. You need to find the same objects and build them in a line horizontally, vertically or obliquely at least three items. Then they will disappear from the screen, and you will be given points.

title: Frosty Connection Quest
description: Join us on a frosty adventure with "Frosty Connection Quest," an exhilarating online matching puzzle game meticulously crafted to be super fun for both kids and adults alike. "Frosty Connection Quest" online playground where the whimsy of winter meets the thrill of puzzle-solving. Have fun playing!

title: Advent Mahjong
description: Advent Mahjong is a connect Mahjong in Cristmas setting. By passing a level you get one day closer to Cristmas and the closer you get the more challenging the levels are.

title: Connect 2 Cars
description: Connect 2 Cars: A Super Fun and Addictive Puzzle Game for All Ages. Connect 2 Cars is the ultimate puzzle game designed to entertain kids and adults alike! Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or simply looking for a relaxing and free-to-play game, Connect 2 Cars has something for everyone. Get ready to immerse yourself in hours of engaging gameplay as you challenge your brain and enjoy connecting adorable car tiles.

title: Christmas Connection
description: Christmas Connection is puzzle Match 3 game with a Christmas theme. The wizard chanted a spell and the Christmas items turned into balls, you need to line 3 or more same Christmas items for the rescue. Your mission is to get high score in short time as fast as you can. Have fun!

title: EG Link Dots
description: EG Link  Dots is easy game hold on the screen to drag from each dot Try to connect all the dots with the same color
